The petitioner is sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for a period of 20 years for the offence punishable under Section 376(3), 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.
The petitioner's application for parole is rejected on the ground that three other cases are pending against him.
The petitioner cannot be admitted to parole if he stands trial unless he is admitted to bail in the other cases.
